title: Validator results for one company
description: One file per company at results/<company-id>.json. Each entry describes what the company's validator did with one test file.

company.description: Company name. Must match the name in owners.json.

date.description: Date the results were produced, as YYYY-MM-DD.

file.description: Path of the test file relative to testfiles/, e.g. conformant/2.5/photo.jpg.

c2paValid.description: Is this a valid C2PA file according to the validator?

aiStatus.description: The AI label the validator gave the file.

userMessage.description: The text that would be shown to a user to describe this file.

error.description: The error text, or null when there is no error.

signals.description: The signals the validator used to reach its verdict.
